defects: Zoubida's arms hang stiffly down her sides while she tilts her head up, and no flies are visible in the frame despite the line 'Des colonies de mouches envahirent la maison'
tiles.fix: Add a slight defensive hand gesture or swatting motion and composite animated flies overhead.

defects: Zoubida's right hand clips into the front of her yellow waist sash and her left fingers clip into her hip/skirt
Her gaze is directed flatly at the left wall rather than up toward the infested beams or across the room
tiles.fix: Pull both hands cleanly onto the outer surface of the hips/sash and angle her head slightly upward toward the ceiling beams.

defects: Wrong acting for beat b007: instead of reaching up toward the door lintel on screen left to place a talisman over the door, Zoubida is turned 3/4 away from the camera facing the back wall with both hands raised to her own forehead/turban (duplicating the peering pose from s03 38.2)
Neither hand is anywhere near the doorframe
tiles.fix: Step Zoubida closer to the doorframe on screen left and extend her arm high up to touch the lintel above the door as if fixing a talisman.

defects: Zoubida is turned 3/4 away from the camera facing the back-left corner, completely hiding her face and squinting expression behind her headscarf
Her raised right hand clips into the side of her turban while her left elbow juts out awkwardly, making the pose read as holding her head rather than peering up at the ceiling beams
Missing contact shadows under her slippers on the floor step
tiles.fix: Rotate Zoubida into a 3/4 front view near the center-left of the room so the camera clearly sees her face and eyes squinting up at the ceiling beams with one hand shading her brow.

defects: The dish cloth (torchon) is an un-deformed, completely rigid flat rectangular board sticking out of Zoubida's right hand like a piece of cardboard with zero cloth drape or whipping bend
Zoubida is turned 3/4 away from the camera facing the back wall, hiding her face and directing the swatting action into the rear wall
Her left hand is raised awkwardly right behind her right wrist
tiles.fix: Deform/rig the dish cloth so it curves and arcs dynamically like fabric being whipped, and turn Zoubida into a 3/4 front/profile view facing toward screen right.

defects: The dish cloth remains a rigid, un-bent rectangular plane glued at a fixed angle to her right hand, merely lowered to waist level
Zoubida still has her back turned 3/4 to the camera facing the rear wall instead of driving the flies toward the open window on screen right, and no flies are visible exiting the window
tiles.fix: Turn Zoubida toward the window on screen right in a dynamic follow-through whipping pose with a curved, draping cloth and composite flies streaming out the window.

worst_problem: In b007–b009 (s03 28.8 to s03 53.1), Zoubida stands with her back turned 3/4 to the camera facing the rear wall across all four wide shots—reusing the ceiling-peering pose instead of reaching for the door lintel in s03 28.8, and waving a rigid, un-deformed cardboard-like rectangle instead of a draping dish cloth in s03 48.7 and s03 53.1.
